consumerAffiliateDecision.reason: Fire detection, alarm, voice evacuation and emergency lighting are life-safety systems whose backup power, supervision, interfaces and test requirements depend on the approved project, building use, applicable rules and exact manufacturer design. A generic UPS, battery or retail device cannot safely establish compliance or continuity.

excludedConsumerAffiliateClasses: generic UPS or external power supply presented as a fire-alarm continuity solution
replacement fire-panel battery without exact manufacturer project and charging-system verification
standalone smoke alarm presented as a substitute for a required building fire-alarm system
emergency light presented as proof of escape-route compliance or guaranteed runtime
fire alarm panel detector manual call point siren strobe or voice-evacuation component
door-holder elevator smoke-control access-control or monitoring interface component
fixed wiring circuit modification or bypass of fault supervision
